pattern.short_summary: A chain of generative transformations is placed inside the user's perceptual path, so that what the user perceives is the pipeline's reconstruction rather than the captured signal.
pattern.definition: A chain of generative transformations is placed inside the user's perceptual path, so that what the user perceives is the pipeline's reconstruction rather than the captured signal. The original signal is not shown alongside; it is displaced, and the mediation is continuous and unavoidable while the system is worn or running. The category covers both readings of that arrangement: the plain control-flow case, where the pipeline simply sits between the scene and the display; and the case where the arrangement exists so that a property of the model is conveyed by making the user *undergo* its effects on their own perception rather than by describing, plotting or explaining it. Where a paper states only the experiential purpose, the interposed pipeline is still what is coded.
pattern.structural_signature: Capture → transform₁ → … → transformₙ → display, wired in series with no bypass: the sensor's output never reaches the display directly, and the display shows only the terminal transform's output. The chain typically crosses representations (signal → symbolic → signal), and the loss at each crossing is what the user perceives. Transplants to audio (mic → transcript → resynthesis → earpiece), text streams, or any sensed-and-displayed channel. For the experiential reading the same wiring holds, with one additional negative residue: no explanatory or visualization element for the model property being conveyed appears anywhere in the interface.

dimension.category_description: How interaction crosses sensory, physical, spatial, embodied, or representational channels.
dimension.classification_boundary: The channel, embodiment, or rendering must be the load-bearing interface mechanism.

evidence.quote: Our pipeline combines in-situ 3D scene understanding, AI-driven spatial reasoning, and style-aware generation to create personalized virtual environments grounded in physical reality.

evidence.quote: It feeds the HTML code of web elements that may contain deceptive patterns into a large language model (LLM) and iteratively prompts it to make these elements less manipulative.

candidates.title: From Seeing it to Experiencing it: Interactive Evaluation of Intersectional Voice Bias in Human-AI Speech Interaction

candidates.title: WebPerceptor: An Open Source Chromium Plugin for Real-Time LLM-Based In-Line, In-Browser Re-Writing of Website Content

evidence.quote: We introduce the "AI Mediated Web", an automatic, personalised, inline, real-time remixing of web content by an LLM based on given prompts and presented in-browser such that the user perceives the end result as a published web page.

evidence.quote: Then the compiled shader is applied to the material of the quad rendering the passthrough video, enabling real-time visual perception transformation.

candidates.title: Same Voice, Different Language: An Exploration of Voice-Cloned Translation to Support Non-Native Speakers in Online Meetings

evidence.quote: Real-time captioning and translation can render a speaker’s words into another language as on-screen text or synthesized speech using generic voices [34, 48]

candidates.title: Semantic See-through Goggles: Wearing Linguistic Virtual Reality in (Artificial) Intelligence

evidence.quote: The system inserts a serial image-to-text and text-to-image transformation pipeline between the camera and head-mounted display (HMD) of video see-through goggles: the live view is converted into a single line of text, then re-generated as an image, and only this mediated image reaches the wearer’s eyes.
